main.description: Lists indexed funding receipt records without collapsing payments. Distinct filters combine with AND; values within each array use OR. from and to accept plain strings but the server must reject the whole request if any entry is not a DID or full record AT-URI, identifying the parameter and entry, explaining the accepted formats, and telling callers to resolve handles to DIDs. A DID matches only the party's DID variant; an AT-URI matches only its strong-reference URI, without CID comparison. These filters do not match free text or resolve wallets; omitted from adds no sender condition. forUris matches record.for.uri without CID comparison. transactionIds match exact identifiers without normalization. Repeated unbracketed array keys accept at most 100 values each; duplicates are removed. Results sort by (createdAt, uri), default desc, with an opaque cursor bound to sortDirection. The full receipt record and hydrated publisher are returned without target expansion or a duplicate parties projection. A receipt is not proof of payment; operational failures return errors, not empty pages. Authentication is not required.

authors.description: Publisher repository DIDs, including facilitator, personal, and group repositories; OR within this filter.

uris.description: Exact funding-receipt AT-URIs for bounded batch hydration; OR within this filter.

from.description: Mixed DID or full record AT-URI identifiers. DIDs match only the record's from DID variant; AT-URIs match only its strong-reference URI. Free text and wallet-to-DID expansion do not match; invalid entries reject the whole request with the parameter and entry identified.

to.description: Mixed DID or full record AT-URI identifiers. DIDs match only the record's to DID variant; AT-URIs match only its strong-reference URI. Free text and wallet-to-DID expansion do not match; invalid entries reject the whole request with the parameter and entry identified.

forUris.description: Funded-target AT-URIs matched against record.for.uri only, without CID comparison.

transactionIds.description: Exact transaction identifier matches; values are not normalized or generically lowercased.

sortDirection.description: Sort direction for (createdAt, uri); default desc.

limit.description: Maximum receipts in the page; default 25.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor bound to sortDirection; keep other parameters unchanged between pages.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: A filter or page parameter is invalid. For from/to values, identify the failing parameter and entry, require a valid DID or full record AT-URI, and tell callers to resolve handles to DIDs.

errors.name: ReceiptQueryFailed
errors.description: The receipt query or publisher hydration lookup failed; retry after checking the HappyView PostgreSQL service.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; omitted when there is no next page.
